info.title: School Management System — API
info.description:
## Enterprise School Management SaaS API

### Authentication
Click **Authorize**, enter system admin credentials to log in.
Swagger will inject the Bearer token automatically on all requests.

### Multi-Tenancy
Set `X-Tenant-ID` to the tenant slug for tenant-scoped endpoints.
Leave it blank for system admin (`/api/v1/admin/...`) endpoints.

### Versioning
API is versioned via URL path: `/api/v1/...`

### Rate Limiting
Rate limits apply per tenant. See response headers for limits.

SelfRegisterRequest.description: Public self-registration request. Unlike CreateUserRequest (used by authenticated admin endpoints), this DTO has no roles field — self-registered users are always created with no roles and must be granted access by a tenant administrator. This is intentional: the public /auth/register endpoint is unauthenticated, so it must never accept caller-supplied privileges.
